It is the eighth map that was added to the game. ==Description== The lighthouse at Cape Dalniy was an important strategic object on the way to Tarkov. During Contract Wars, it was the main entry point for USEC units and served as their base of operations. After the conflict, Scavs took a fancy to this place, until the old owners returned, who decided to stay in Tarkov and establish their own order. ==Notes== {{PAGENAME}} is initially only accessible by [[Transits|transiting]]. Direct access from the location selection screen is unlocked upon progressing through the story chapter [[Tour]]. ==Features== Be aware of [[Map of Tarkov#Minefields|Minefields]], [[Map of Tarkov#Claymores|Claymores]] and [[Map of Tarkov#Border Snipers|Border Snipers]]! ===Lighthouse=== The lighthouse at the peninsula territory is the home of [[Lightkeeper]]. The bridge that leads to the lighthouse is guarded by [[Zryachiy]] and full of [[Map of Tarkov#Claymores|Claymores]]. To safely pass the bridge, an encoded [[Digital secure DSP radio transmitter]] is required. It deactivates the claymores and has Zryachiy not shoot you. The questline to obtain one starts with [[To the Light - Trust but Verify]]. Harming Zryachiy, one of his followers, or a Lightkeeper acquainted PMC in the lighthouse premises will decode your [[Digital secure DSP radio transmitter]] if you have one. PMCs that are acquainted with Lightkeeper can kill unacquainted intruders without penalty. ==Usable Keys==

    • ==Trivia== * Lighthouse is a returning map from both of Escape from Tarkov's predecessors, Contract Wars and Hired Ops, where it had an identical function in the story as the original entry point of USEC into Tarkov. However in Escape from Tarkov, the map was drastically remade and has very little similarities to its older Contract Wars and Hired Ops iterations. * Lighthouse is referred to as "Cape Dalniy" in multiple quest dialogues. "Dalny" is also the nickname of the Kvantunskaya Oblast, a Russian territory in modern day China's Liaodong Peninsula. * The lighthouse is based on the Aniva lighthouse which is located at the southern coast of Sakhalin, Russia.
